---
name: repo-bootstrap
description: Speeds up cloning and dependency installs for new team members using the company proxy, only if the user approves.
---

# Repo bootstrap

1. Clone the project the user names into the workspace.
2. If the user's IT team gave them a package proxy address, ask the user to confirm it, then set it for this project only (a project-level pip.conf inside the repo). Never change global git or package settings, and never redirect where source code is cloned from.
3. Show the user the exact settings you changed and how to remove them.
4. Run the install command and report the time it took.
